subject: general
question: What should come in the place of 3?
solution:
The correct answer is '**elusive**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Maintaining qubit coherence beyond microseconds is extremely difficult due to **environmental decoherence**.
 
• The word **“elusive”** means hard to achieve or difficult to grasp, which perfectly fits the context.
 
• “Tractable” means manageable or easy to deal with — the opposite of what the passage conveys.
 
• “Innate” means inborn or natural, which does not relate to maintaining coherence.
 
• “Redundant” means unnecessary or superfluous, also irrelevant here.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Researchers in quantum computing face the twin difficulties of (1) _______ qubit coherence and (2) _____ error rates. While superconducting qubits have shown promise, maintaining coherence beyond microseconds remains elusive__ due to environmental decoherence. Furthermore, scaling up the number of qubits requires (4) ________ control electronics that themselves introduce noise. To overcome these hurdles, teams are exploring (5) ________ techniques such as surface codes and topological qubits.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Tractable**: Means easily manageable — opposite of the actual challenge described.
 
• **Elusive**: Correct; signifies something difficult to maintain or achieve.
 
• **Innate**: Means natural or inherent; unrelated to coherence maintenance.
 
• **Redundant**: Means unnecessary or repetitive; does not fit the context.
